mapper.insert: INSERT INTO outbox (event_type, payload, status, retry_count, create_time) VALUES (#{eventType}, #{payload}, #{status}, #{retryCount}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, event_type, payload, status, retry_count, create_time FROM outbox WHERE status = 0 ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE outbox SET status = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE outbox SET retry_count = retry_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
